name: DuckDuckGo AI Chat (duck.ai)
description: DuckDuckGo AI Chat — private, anonymous AI chat via duck.ai. Routes through multiple providers (OpenAI GPT-5.x, Anthropic Claude 4.x, Meta Llama 4, Mistral, Kimi K2). No account required.
author: ui2api capability package

transport.protocol: POST /duckchat/v1/chat → text/event-stream (SSE); frames are JSON lines or bracket-marked markers ([PING]/[DONE]/[CHAT_TITLE:…])

auth.vqdToken: GET /status with x-vqd-accept:1 → response header carries VQD token → included in chat POST headers → new VQD returned in each chat response header for next request
auth.ddgAccountOptional: POST /duckchat/v1/auth/authorize → /auth/token → internal_duckchat_user cookie; enables chat history sync only

headers.vqd: server-issued anonymous session token, refreshed per-request (header name obfuscated in module exports, historically x-vqd-4)

transport.streaming: SSE frames: JSON lines (action:success/error with role, content) + markers ([PING], [DONE], [CHAT_TITLE:text], [FIXED_COST_WINDOW_USAGE:...], [STOP_REASON:word], [LIMIT_ACCOUNT], [LIMIT_CONVERSATION], [ADS:{windowID}], [SUMMARY_REFRESH_HINT:...], [SUMMARY_INVALID], [WARN_CONVERSATION_LIMIT:n])

capabilities.name: Chat stream
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the composer; SSE-streamed answer via POST /duckchat/v1/chat (accept: text/event-stream). Model configurable per message.
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)
capabilities.implementation: POST /duckchat/v1/chat with JSON body {model, messages[{role,content[{type,text}]}], metadata{toolChoice}, reasoningEffort, canUseWebSearch, ...}; SSE response parsed for [DONE], assistant role content, error markers. VQD token from GET /status preflight.

capabilities.name: Web search toggle
capabilities.description: Toggle in-chat web search (metadata.toolChoice.WebSearch → backend performs search, injects results + citations)
capabilities.implementation: Composer 'Tools' button → popover row "Web Search / Source answers from the web" ([role='menuitemradio']); enabled state read back from the composer chip button[aria-label='Remove Web Search']. VERIFIED live 2026-09-23 (headed Xvfb): enable→chip, chat after enable carried a REAL WebSearch tool-invocation with 5 citations in saved-chats.

capabilities.name: Model picker read
capabilities.description: Read available AI models from the embedded bundle config (gpt-4o/5.x, claude-sonnet-4-x/opus-4-x, llama-4, mistral-small, kimi-k2-5)
capabilities.implementation: Composer model chip (text '5.6 Luna', w≈100 h≈32) opens [role='menu'][aria-label='Choose a model']; rows are [role='menuitemradio'] with data-testid="model-picker-row-<id>" and aria-checked="true" on the active model. VERIFIED live 2026-09-23: 6 rows read (GPT-5.6 Luna selected, GPT-5.4 mini, Claude Haiku 4.5, Mistral Small 4, gpt-oss 120B, Gemma 4 31B BETA). Post-chat composer hides the chip → New Chat retry.

capabilities.name: File / image upload
capabilities.description: Attach files and images to a chat message (base64-encoded in request body)
capabilities.implementation: Attach button (button[aria-label='Add images or PDFs']) wraps input[type='file'] accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif,application/pdf,.pdf"; setInputFiles → attachment chip button[aria-label^='Remove image '] read-back. VERIFIED live 2026-09-23 with a 1x1 PNG (chip 'Remove image 1'). Content parts: {type:'image', mimeType, image:dataUrl} or {type:'file', content:base64, encoding:'base64', mimeType, filename}.

capabilities.name: Reasoning mode
capabilities.description: Set reasoning effort (fast / reasoning / extended) for supported models
capabilities.implementation: Composer button[aria-label='Reasoning mode'] text Fast/Reasoning; popover rows [role='menuitemradio'] 'Reasoning Takes longer to respond' / 'Fast Answers right away'. VERIFIED live 2026-09-23: selecting flips the button text (read-back). 'extended' is NOT offered for the free-tier GPT-5.6 Luna composer (measured limit, honest ok:false). reasoningEffort rides the chat POST; extendedThinking in request metadata for plus/pro models.

capabilities.name: Chat history (local or synced)
capabilities.description: Read recent chats from IndexedDB (anonymous, device-local) or DDG-account sync
capabilities.implementation: Anonymous chats live in IndexedDB 'savedAIChatData' (v6), stores saved-chats / pre-canonical-chats keyed by chatId {title, model, messages[], reasoningMode, lastEdit, pinned}; sidebar input[aria-label='Search chats'] + per-row button[aria-label='Delete Chat'] corroborate. VERIFIED live 2026-09-23 (sendProbe read-back: 'Abilities list' row, model gpt-5.6-luna, stored + sidebar match). DDG sync via /duckchat/v1/auth/* + internal_duckchat_user cookie (optional).

models.note: Model list is embedded in the JS bundle (NOT fetched from a /models endpoint). The following are the literal model IDs found. Subscription tier (free/plus/pro) gates access server-side.

auth.note: ANONYMOUS: chat works without login. VQD token obtained from GET /status with x-vqd-accept:1 header — refreshed per chat response. DDG account (internal_duckchat_user cookie) is optional for chat history sync. No cookies needed for anonymous chat. provider-catalog duckduckgo-web cookie duckai is NOT required for anonymous usage.
auth.anonymousMechanism: GET /duckchat/v1/status (x-vqd-accept:1) → response header → token → POST /duckchat/v1/chat header → new token in chat response header

ddgAccount.purpose: chat history sync across devices only; chat functionality not gated on this

analysisMethod: static curl + 3 JS bundles (~4.3MB) from duck.ai (the final 302 target of duckduckgo.com/?ia=chat and /aichat); no browser launched
